:::{#def-symmetric-bilinear-form}
#### Symmetric bilinear form

A **symmetric bilinear form**
[@wikipedia_bilinear_form]
is a [bilinear form](#def-bilinear-form) $\bformfn{\matr{A}}$
whose [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix) $\matr{A}$ is [symmetric](#def-symmetric-matrix):

$$
\tp{\matr{A}} = \matr{A}.
$$

:::
